title: WhatsApp order capture with delivery-day awareness
description: Turn WhatsApp into a real order-capture channel: structured extraction of name/product/address, explicit confirmation flow, SALE_WON with full data packet to owner. Add prompt rule: never promise delivery days/times until they exist in knowledge; use them automatically when the business adds delivery info later.

classification.rationale: Classified as COMPLEX complexity. Complexity drivers: 8 files affected, AI behaviour changes, cross-cutting (multi-domain), category requires council. Required agents (9): architect, backend, frontend, ai_engineer, performance, security, qa, release, memory_engineer.

decisions.rationale: WhatsApp as order-capture channel: no schema changes, reuse customers.phone/address/city + mia_signals action_payload JSONB; design validated by Mia Landings council (sanity/hook-master)
Extra AI call already gated by hasSalesTrigger + slice(-12) + max_tokens 300; add missing phone triggers only; no unbounded cost
detect.ts+events.ts+process.ts extensions are backward-compatible (optional params, additive JSONB payload)
No new secrets, no cross-tenant risk; phone/address only from customer row scoped by business_id; bridge secret flow unchanged
No UI changes; only prompt dictionary + sales pipeline
Quality gates: lint+build+unit+e2e+devtools; will verify mia_signals payload contains phone/address after deploy
Delivery-day rule is conditional: never promise dates without knowledge; auto-activates when owner adds knowledge item (existing formatKnowledge injection)
Atomic commits per file group; push + vercel --prod + HTTP 200 verification
Decision recorded: WhatsApp order capture + conditional delivery-day rule (ADR-010 compliant, no schema change)
